recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a dead man's switch: nightly-sync pings a monitoring endpoint such as healthchecks.io when it succeeds, and the user is alerted if no ping arrives by 03:10.
note: I rated it SMALL because it recommends one alert, though it hedges by offering a self-hosted Synology option alongside healthchecks.io, puts off central logging as a later nice-to-have, and has none of the four labelled lines.
